* '''PC-E1''' ([[Mustafar: Private Platform (Docking Bay) (Errata)]]): '''First published 31 May 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/hires/mustafarprivateplatformdockingbay.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb commit 13a5f3a]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Card image published 1 June 2022<ref name="img-2022-06-01-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/mustafarprivateplatformdockingbay.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/mustafarprivateplatformdockingbay.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: Once per turn, may deploy a starfighter with 'Vader' in title here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: Your docking bay transit to or from here requires +4 Force (+6 Force if Vader or Vanee here).” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (the side credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed; on some cards icons or the set-icon position also changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version). This image was first published on 31 May 2022 as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/hires/mustafarprivateplatformdockingbay.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb commit 13a5f3a]); the card-size GIF uploaded 11 June 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c commit 6894629], earlier listed as its own version, PC-E2) is a later copy of the same image in another format, so it is not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
